title: Xoom 160 Adventure Scooter Concept
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Hero MotoCorp Xoom 160 Adventure Scooter Concept is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 160cc powertrain delivering 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 110 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Step-Through Upright posture paired with an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
